title: Ring entry
description: A single entry in ring.json. See docs/submission-form-spec.md section 2.1 for the field-by-field notes.

externalMediaUrl.description: An https URL to media hosted somewhere the creator controls, never on IndieNodes itself. The no-rehosting principle is the whole shape of this project, and encoding it here means `npm run validate:publish` enforces it on every entry rather than it living only as a sentence in the submission spec. `maxLength` is the same rough ceiling browsers and servers already treat as a practical URL length limit -- generous for any real URL, a bound against a pathological one. Whether the URL actually resolves somewhere safe (not a private IP, not localhost, no embedded credentials) is `validate-ring.js`'s job, not this schema's: that rule needs a private-IP-range table a JSON Schema pattern cannot cleanly express, and it already exists once, in `member-health.js`.

creator_id.description: Stable identifier linking this creator's nodes together. Assigned by the submission workflow, not the form. A data-only link: no ranking or weighting logic reads it. At most two nodes may share a creator_id, enforced as a moderation-checklist rule rather than in this schema.

why.description: A node represents a creator, not a single work: this is the one-line pitch where the creator makes their case, introduction and framing combined. Matches submissionValidation.js's own WHY_MAX_LENGTH -- that file used to be the only place this was enforced; now both agree, rather than the schema silently trusting a client-side cap it could not see.

tags.description: At least one. Tags are how an entry becomes reachable: an untagged entry is invisible to the tag filters and to the tag list in Settings, so it would join the ring already unfindable by every route except scrolling past it. Capped at 20 as a sanity bound, not a product target -- real entries carry a handful.

tracks.description: Audio only, and optional. Capped at three so the ring stays a sampler, not a full catalog host. An audio entry with no tracks is a deliberate, supported shape: a link-only member, listed in the ring with its cover and a link out but not playable in-app. Playback needs a direct file the browser can fetch cross-origin (see docs/open-questions.md), which not every creator can supply, and refusing those creators entry would serve the ring worse than listing them.

pages.description: Comic only. Capped at three, matching tracks/artworks/excerpts's own "sampler, not a full catalog host" reasoning above -- the one media array that had been left uncapped, not a deliberate exception.

artworks.description: Art only. One to three works selected to represent the creator rather than a full catalog.

alt.description: A meaningful text alternative for the artwork.

excerpts.description: Text only. Between one and three short samples. Each sample's own audio is optional: when a creator supplies none, the reader hears an automatic text-to-speech reading instead. Two item shapes are valid on purpose: the object form every new submission produces, and the bare string form entries published before samples carried their own audio. Both are accepted so existing member files stay valid without a migration; `normalizeEntry` in src/lib/ring.js lifts the string form to the object form at read time, so nothing downstream of it sees two shapes.

title.description: Optional name for this sample — a chapter, an essay title, a poem's first line. Omitted is a complete sample, not an incomplete one: an excerpt from an untitled piece has nothing to put here.

text.description: Sanitized HTML for this sample. 5000 characters is generous room for a genuine short excerpt -- a few paragraphs -- while still bounding how much any one sample can grow.

audio_url.description: The creator's own recording of this sample, read aloud. Omitted means text-to-speech is used instead.

oneOf.description: Legacy plain-text sample, still valid and never rewritten in place. New submissions emit the object form above.

thumb_url.description: Cover or representative image for the entry: album art, a header image, a screenshot. Required for game entries (see allOf below); optional and encouraged for every other type, where the field view uses it as the card's background instead of a flat color wash. Comics and Art fall back to their first page or artwork when this is absent.

thumb_position.description: Normalized focal point for cropping a cover inside a node. Percentages remain stable as the node is resized; omitted entries default to the center.

preview_url.description: Game only. Muted preview, never autoplaying audio.

trailer_url.description: Game only. Optional YouTube trailer; loaded only after an explicit play action.

explicit.description: Self-declared: the entry contains explicit adult content. Hidden by default; visitors opt in to seeing it in Settings. Omit for everything else.

verification_token.description: Opaque string confirming submitter control of source_url or a third-party profile page.

joined_at.description: UTC timestamp this entry first appeared in members/. Set automatically by build-ring.js the first time a member file is built without one — never hand-edited, same spirit as verification_token being explicit rather than derived. audio-key-jay and comic-kjc-comix (present before this field existed) carry the date it was introduced, not their true historical join date; see docs/whats-new-feed.md.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent substantive edit, set explicitly by whoever makes it (the /update flow, or a maintainer editing by hand) — not auto-derived, for the same reason ring.json itself carries no generated_at. Omitted means never updated since joining.

_placeholder.description: Marks a seed or example entry. Real submissions must omit this field.
